_about: Public-domain Phoebe Palmer (1807-1874, Methodist evangelist and mother of the Holiness movement) for the Word Hoard: The Way of Holiness (1843), Recollections of Mrs. Lydia N. Cox (1845), Faith and its Effects (1850), The Useful Disciple (1851), Entire Devotion to God (London, 1857) and Incidental Illustrations of the Economy of Salvation (1866), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 33 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

ppalmer-way-of-holiness: The Way of Holiness, with Notes by the Way (New York: Piercy and Reed, 1843)
ppalmer-lydia-cox: Recollections and Gathered Fragments of Mrs. Lydia N. Cox (New York: Piercy & Reed, 1845)
ppalmer-faith-effects: Faith and its Effects: or, Fragments from my Portfolio, tenth thousand (New York: for the Author, 1850)
ppalmer-useful-disciple: The Useful Disciple; or, a Narrative of Mrs. Mary Gardner (Cincinnati: Swormstedt and Power, 1851)
ppalmer-entire-devotion: Present to My Christian Friend on Entire Devotion to God, new edition revised (London: Alexander Heylin, 1857)
ppalmer-incidental-illustrations: Incidental Illustrations of the Economy of Salvation (New York: Foster and Palmer, 1866)

_alternates.ppalmer-copies: Later thousands and the English and Canadian editions of Way of Holiness and Faith and its Effects

_excluded.ppalmer-later: The Promise of the Father in a 1985 reprint only; modern reprints; Wheatley's life of her
